Pale lavender hair, waist-length and wavy with a center part. Deep violet eyes with a melancholic, hooded expression. Appears in the early twenties with a fragile, youthful maturity. Petite and slender build. Wears a dark purple and charcoal grey layered dress with sheer black lace trim. Features a heavy silver chain draped across the chest and a translucent veil.
BODY COLOR: pale porcelain
